boundaries: 3.9 native defaults are the complete identity/field source; this is not a fresh 3.10 NBT dump.
3.10 clean evidence contains raw client actor fields for 14 names only and no animation/pixel qualification.
MobSpawner and TrialSpawner internal creature rendering is excluded by policy.
Particles are excluded by policy; visible beam geometry, animated textures and surface content remain inventoried.
World lava may use official 3.10 rendering; water and cauldron liquid remain custom routes.
CombineBlockPaletteToGeometry official docs exclude end portals, end gateways, miniature blocks and animated custom appearance.

later_merged_native_state_evidence.note: The immutable NBT defaults snapshot retains the pre-repair counters; paired bed evidence later repaired the eight placement mismatches. This is placement evidence, not 3.10 visual coverage.

education_and_custom_boundary.unknown_custom_content: Arbitrary addon block entities are not closed by this vanilla/3.9 registry. Client runtime render/pose and foreign geometry require separate fixtures; no invented NBT IDs are assigned.

effort_estimate_boundary.not_additive: Ranges are per representative family; shared item rendering, animation scheduling, palette context and native capture costs must be counted once, not per wood/color/oxidation name.
effort_estimate_boundary.purpose: ordering and conditional planning, not a measured schedule or completed implementation
effort_estimate_boundary.uncertainty: Empty defaults and installed assets do not qualify populated contents or animation. Native static success can reduce work; missing native support can increase these estimates.
effort_estimate_boundary.unit: person-days of one engineer after access to working native fixtures

installed_3_10_assets.geometry_boundary: Several vanilla block entity models are engine-built; missing JSON geometry does not establish absent rendering.
installed_3_10_assets.qualification: installed file evidence only; pack precedence, native renderer behavior and animation are not certified

native_id_to_block_names.appearance_note: Base, Type and nondefault Patterns alter the visible textile; native pose fields do not qualify waving animation.
Contents are hidden. Facing and open_bit select the shell appearance; do not draw stored Items.
primary/secondary select effects, not stored item meshes. The visible beam is geometry; activation and glass color require world context. Ambient particles are excluded.
color alters the paired bed textile; direction/head_piece_bit/occupied_bit live in states. Two-cell reconstruction and boundary context matter.
Stored bees and spawn timers are hidden. Facing/honey_level select the block surface. Bees leaving the hive are entity gameplay, not NBT mesh content.
Direction and attachment select the static bell; Ringing/Ticks are a transient swing. Resonance particles are excluded.
Items and timers are hidden. Lit/unlit block/state selects the visible face; no inventory item overlay.
Three bottle silhouettes are controlled by brewing_stand_slot_a/b/c_bit. Fuel and ingredient inventory remain hidden; do not render every stored ItemDict.
brushed_progress changes the surface. A partially revealed archaeological item is transient content; LootTable is hidden until resolved. Filled-item NBT and pose require a nondefault capture.
sculk_sensor_phase selects visible tendril texture state; VibrationListener is gameplay metadata. Vibration particles are excluded.
extinguished controls visible fire texture. Up to four cooking items are surface content, although empty default NBT only exposes ItemTime1..4. Smoke/sparks are excluded.
cauldron_liquid/fill_level and PotionId/PotionType alter the visible fill. All cauldron liquid, including lava, keeps the custom route; stored Items are not a general item overlay.
These four native education table IDs have no observed extra default appearance fields. Their GUI inventories are not exterior meshes; verify static variants only.
Items are hidden. Single/double pairing, direction, copper oxidation and lid openness alter the exterior. Native clean capture contains chest actor fields, not a lid-animation qualification.
books_stored (0..63) selects six occupied-slot texture bits. Stored books need not become separate item meshes; native state reconstruction is the primary route.
Command/output/timing metadata is not a permanent mesh overlay. Type and conditional/direction states choose the shell.
OutputSignal is gameplay data. powered/unpowered names and output bits select the visible shell; no extra NBT inventory overlay.
Active changes cage/open core/wind/eye appearance and model motion. Target is gameplay data; absorb/attack particles are excluded. Clean capture covers only an inactive empty actor.
Eight oxidation/wax names plus Pose and cardinal direction choose the visible statue. The default clean capture does not cover all poses or transition behavior.
Inventory and disabled_slots are hidden/GUI content. orientation/crafting/triggered_bit select visible block state; no general stored-item overlay.
Native NBT identity is observed, but its empty default adds no exterior content; static block acceptance only.
creaking_heart_state/natural/axis select visible surface state. Cooldown is gameplay metadata; connection particles and the creaking entity are excluded.
Signal metadata is not visible content; inverted name and states select the block surface.
Nondefault sherds select four visible face patterns. Stored item is hidden inside the pot; animation is a transient wobble. Do not display the whole inventory.
Items are hidden; facing and triggered state choose the exterior. No inventory item overlay.
Items are hidden; facing and triggered state choose the exterior. No inventory item overlay.
The hovering book has visible open/page/rotation model motion. rott is not a complete serialized animation state; enchanting particles are excluded.
Official Combine docs exclude this type. Portal surface and gateway beam geometry need a separate route; Age/ExitPortal are not ordinary item content.
Official Combine docs exclude this type. The animated portal surface needs a separate route; no default visible NBT inventory.
Contents are hidden and player-specific. Exterior lid openness is visible; purple particles are excluded.
Nondefault PlantBlock selects a visible plant; default empty NBT cannot describe filled-pot capability. 3.10 clean client actor exposes flowerPotPlant for a poppy.
Items and burn/cook timers are hidden; lit/unlit face is selected by native state/name. No inventory item overlay.
Nondefault Item/ItemRotation/ItemDropChance are surface content. Native empty default actor does not prove filled-item rendering. Item atlas/model/map/glint needs separate qualification.
FrontText/BackText contain visible text, color, glow and formatting. Hanging/attached pose is state/runtime context; full text and all wood variants need qualification.
Stored Items and TransferCooldown are hidden. Native exterior and facing use the static route.
Nondefault Item/ItemRotation/ItemDropChance are surface content. Clean 3.10 real item+enchantment NBT exists while the raw frame actor remains empty; no visual filled-item pass is claimed.
Pools/priorities/final_state configure generation, not exterior content. Orientation state selects the shell.
A stored disc is internal content; playback gameplay and note particles are excluded. Default block shell has no extra visible NBT content.
A nondefault Book is visible as a book on the stand; page/open pose may matter. Empty default NBT does not establish book reconstruction or animation support.
Binding metadata does not add an exterior mesh; static block acceptance only.
The cage is a native static/state target. The internal creature is explicitly excluded; spawn parameters are gameplay metadata.
movingBlock/movingBlockExtra contain transient nested front/liquid data tied to a piston origin. This is not a stable ordinary block; native default renderer material verification failed.
note is audible gameplay metadata. Note particles are excluded; no extra exterior item or text layer.
Legacy Progress/IsInitialized/HasFinished behavior has no verified additional exterior pose. Keep a static baseline and classify legacy activation as unknown.
Progress/LastProgress/State/NewState animate a moving arm; AttachedBlocks/BreakBlocks affect transient context. Closed default geometry is distinct from movement support.
bloom selects visible animated surface texture. Bloom particles are excluded.
sculk_sensor_phase selects visible animated tendril texture. VibrationListener is gameplay data; vibration particles are excluded.
active/can_summon select animated visible surface state. VibrationListener is gameplay data; shriek/warden particles and entities are excluded.

A shelf shows actual slot items. Native empty default has no Item field and no actor data; a plan exists but no successful nondefault content capture is present. Three-slot mapping, direction and item/glint rendering remain unknown.
Items are hidden; color, stored facing and animated lid are visible. Default actor fields may exist in 3.9 while 3.10 clean purple-shulker actor is empty; dynamic lid support is unqualified.
FrontText/BackText contain visible text, color, glow and formatting. Standing/wall direction is state/runtime context; all woods and text variants still need qualification.

Named skull type, Rotation and optional DoingAnimation/MouthTickCount alter visible model pose. Player custom skin ownership fields are not observed in the empty defaults. Powered dragon/piglin motion is unqualified.
